author: imryaan
body:
May I present you my third map, Industrial CTF!

I've been working on some different / unique block palettes and I've thought of this :

Pictures :
http://imgur.com/a/PgpKS (Map) might've taken to many screenies but nvm.
Spawn Kit :
http://imgur.com/i8qFNK1  
Contributors / Helpers : Xuph, Crimson_Aught, Legoche, Prodigy
XML :https://github.com/Prodigy4532/Prodigy4532XML/blob/master/XML%20-%20OCN/Industrial.xml
World Download : http://www.mediafire.com/download/vamoldtu86ziebu/Industrial.rar


If you want to see the map in game, just go on alexanderjoe's build server and do /mvtp Industrial
All criticism and opinions are welcome!
-Ryan
